lines.zh: 我亮一下，暗一下，往前飞。
lines.en: I glow, go dark, and drift forward.

lines.zh: 沼泽上的雾很低，我贴着飞。
lines.en: The swamp fog is low; I skim above it.

lines.zh: 我绕着一根芦苇转圈子。
lines.en: I loop around a reed.

lines.zh: 红树林的水面映着我的光。
lines.en: The mangrove water echoes my light.

lines.zh: 同伴在前头亮着，我跟着。
lines.en: A companion glows ahead; I follow.

lines.zh: 我飞一段就熄了，省点力。
lines.en: I fly a stretch, then go dark to save strength.

lines.zh: 水汽很重，我的翅膀发黏。
lines.en: The air is thick and my wings feel tacky.
I drift over a lily pad.

lines.zh: 我往上飘了一点点，避开草。
lines.en: I rise a little to clear the reeds.

lines.zh: 水面有倒影，我看着自己。
lines.en: There's my reflection on the water.
I fly with the current's direction.

lines.zh: 夜里的沼泽，就我们最亮。
lines.en: On a swamp night, we're the brightest thing.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，回到原来的位置。
lines.en: I circle once and return to where I was.

lines.zh: 我飞到树根下，那里虫子多。
lines.en: I drift to the roots where the small bugs are.
I fly alight, like a little lamp.

lines.zh: 我慢慢降下去，落在草叶上。
lines.en: I descend slowly and settle on a blade.

lines.zh: 我停在叶尖上，一下一下地亮。
lines.en: On a leaf tip, I glow and dim by turns.

lines.zh: 我的光很弱，但一直亮着。
lines.en: My light is faint but constant.
The fog has wrapped around me.
Frogs call on the water, far off.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收起来，凉快些。
lines.en: I fold my wings; it's cooler.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，跟着叶子晃。
lines.en: I hold still and sway with the leaf.

lines.zh: 我的光在雾里散成一小团。
lines.en: My glow blurs into a small halo in the fog.
A moth passes, bigger than me.

lines.zh: 泥水的气味很重，我习惯了。
lines.en: The smell of mud is strong. I'm used to it.
I dim to the lowest and rest.
Reed shadows sway in the water.

lines.zh: 沼泽的夜还长，我先亮着。
lines.en: The swamp night is long, so I keep glowing.
I flash once, then go dark.

lines.zh: 红树林的夜露压弯了我的翅。
lines.en: Night dew in the mangroves weighs my wings down.
Your lamp is far brighter than me.

lines.zh: 我飞到你面前，亮了一下。
lines.en: I fly before you and flash once.
Don't swat. I'm only looking.

lines.zh: 你的影子把水面的光挡了。
lines.en: Your shadow has blocked the water's shine.
I settle on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你一动，我尾巴的光就暗了。
lines.en: When you move, the light on my tail dims.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾很低，我贴着飞。
lines.en: The swamp mist is low; I fly just above it.

lines.zh: 这么晚，你怎么还在沼泽里？
lines.en: Why are you still in the swamp this late?
I'll flash for you. Do you know me?
Keep your hand still; I'll be off.
My light stuttered.
My light drifts over the swamp.

lines.zh: 我落进水里，赶紧爬出来。
lines.en: I fall in the water and scramble out.

lines.zh: 我暗了下去，好一会儿才亮。
lines.en: I went dark and took a while to glow again.
This wound makes me fly crooked.
I press to a leaf's underside and keep still.

lines.zh: 我的光弱得几乎看不见。
lines.en: My light is so faint you can hardly see it.
It hurts, but I must keep glowing.
A small piece of my wing is gone.
The others' lights are far away.
That glow — I took it for a companion.
Your lamp's too bright. I'm dazzled.
I drift a little toward it.
Warm things aren't quite my liking.
Still, that light is lovely.
Let me come a bit closer and look.
You've covered it. Why?
My glow can't match yours.
I circled twice, not daring to land.
Fine. I'll back off.

lines.zh: 你碰到我了，我翻了个身。
lines.en: You touched me and I tumbled.
My light went out for a moment.
I rise quickly to get clear.
Your sweat is on my wings.
It's all right; my wings still work.

lines.zh: 你走一步，风就把我吹歪了。
lines.en: One step from you and the wind skews me.

lines.zh: 我落在水面上，差点沉下去。
lines.en: I land on the water and nearly sink.

lines.zh: 撞上你的肩膀，我的光乱闪。
lines.en: I hit your shoulder and my light flickers wild.
Step back so I can fly.

lines.zh: 沼泽的夜，我们四五个一起亮。
lines.en: On swamp nights, four or five of us light up.
I flash three times; you flash three back.
The signal matches. It's you.
Lights over the swamp, patch by patch.
We fly at the same slow pace. Perfect.

lines.zh: 往芦苇深处去吧，那儿没人。
lines.en: Let's go deep into the reeds where no one is.
My light is small. So is yours.
We glow together, and go dark together.
Don't fly far; the fog would scatter you.
The night is long; let us keep glowing slowly.
Look, our lights are in the water.

lines.zh: 叶子上有滴露水，我停上去。
lines.en: A dewdrop on a leaf; I land on it.
This thing is bigger than I am.
I nudge it; it doesn't move.
My feet are too small to hold it.
A petal floats on the water.

lines.zh: 我落在上面，它载着我漂。
lines.en: I land on it and it carries me.
It catches the light. Lovely.
I can't move it, so I just look.
A dead bug. I sniff it.
I won't eat it. I only want light.

lines.zh: 水面上的涟漪，我看得清。
lines.en: I can see the ripples spreading on the water.

lines.zh: 上面的影子很大，不是同伴。
lines.en: That shadow above is big. Not one of us.
I go dark and press under a leaf.
That glow isn't right. It's fire.

lines.zh: 我盯着那个方向，不敢动。
lines.en: I stare that way and dare not move.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在水面上传得远。
lines.en: Your steps carry far across the water.
The others scattered. I should hide too.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，还在靠近。
lines.en: I count your steps. Still coming.
These reeds can hide me.

lines.zh: 你踩断的芦苇，光还在晃。
lines.en: The reed you snapped still sways with my light.

lines.zh: 我看见了，水里那团黑影。
lines.en: I see it — a dark shape in the water.
I won't fly down. Too close.
I flash once and go dark to test you.
Your eyes are following my light.

lines.zh: 我落到水草里，光被遮住。
lines.en: I drop into the weeds and my light is hidden.
I weave through the reeds, never straight.
The closer you come, the dimmer I get.

lines.zh: 沼泽的夜里，我们一群亮着。
lines.en: In the swamp night, we glow in a crowd.
The fog hides half of me.

lines.zh: 水面上的倒影出卖了我。
lines.en: My reflection in the water gives me away.
I fly toward the darker water.
A little longer and you'll go.

lines.zh: 我沿着水面低飞，贴着苇杆。
lines.en: I fly low along the water, hugging the reeds.

lines.zh: 你的手一伸，我就换了个方向。
lines.en: Your hand comes up, and I change direction.

lines.zh: 我撞了你一下，连感觉都没有。
lines.en: I bumped you and you wouldn't even feel it.

lines.zh: 我这力气，只够推开一粒沙。
lines.en: All my strength moves one grain of sand.

lines.zh: 我飞到你眼前，晃了一下。
lines.en: I fly before your eyes and flicker.
The flashing dazzles you, doesn't it.
This is all I can do to drive you off.
I beat my wings at you. Useless.

lines.zh: 我撞在你手背上，自己弹开。
lines.en: I hit your hand and bounce off.
I'm not built for fighting.
I've flown off. Don't follow.
You can't catch me. I'm too small.

lines.zh: 我从水边的草丛里亮起来。
lines.en: I light up in the grass by the water.

lines.zh: 沼泽的夜雾正好护着我。
lines.en: The swamp's night fog shelters me well.
My first glow is very faint.
Companions glow among the reeds.

lines.zh: 水面把我的光映了一遍。
lines.en: The water throws my light back at me.

lines.zh: 我落在浮萍上，歇一会儿。
lines.en: I settle on duckweed to rest a moment.
Plenty of small bugs here.

lines.zh: 夜里的红树林，安静得厉害。
lines.en: The mangrove at night is very still.
I take flight and the fog slides past.
My light flickers between the leaves.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的光就乱了。
lines.en: Fire nears and my light goes wild.
I drop from high into the mud.

lines.zh: 水面合上了，我的光在水下。
lines.en: The water closes over; my light is under it.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的光吹散了一瞬。
lines.en: The blast scatters my light for an instant.

lines.zh: 一支箭带着风掠过我的翅。
lines.en: An arrow's wind buffets my wings.

lines.zh: 那力量把我的光压暗了。
lines.en: That force presses my glow down.

lines.zh: 没有吃的，我的光一天比一天弱。
lines.en: No food, and my light weakens by the day.

lines.zh: 一道白光，比我的亮一万倍。
lines.en: A white flash, ten thousand times my glow.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，也没有虫子，只有黑。
lines.en: No water, no bugs in the void. Only dark.
